description: This file contains unit tests for GatewayConnection security features in a networking application. It tests TLS parameter resolution, auto-connection behavior, manual TLS enforcement, port determination, and fingerprint management in the context of Gateway connections.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionSecurityTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for Gateway connection security functionalities, including TLS parameter resolution, auto-connect behavior, manual TLS policies, port selection, and fingerprint storage management.

methods.name: makeController
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of GatewayConnectionController configured for testing.

methods.name: makeDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Constructs a mock GatewayDiscoveryModel.DiscoveredGateway instance with specified parameters to simulate a discovered gateway.

methods.name: clearTLSFingerprint
methods.description: Clears the stored TLS fingerprint for a given stable ID from the GatewayTLSStore.
